snippet.title: Angel Warrior Gameplay (4K)
snippet.description:
Fly as an archangel through six painterly realms in Angel Warrior, a one-tap arcade action game. Free on iPhone and iPad on November 1, All Saints' Day, with no in-app purchases.

100% of the ad-network revenue the game receives is shared among qualifying partner churches, starting with the next update. Learn more: angelwarriorgame.com/church

Pre-order on the App Store: angelwarriorgame.com/ios
Play the first two levels in your browser: angelwarriorgame.com/play
More info: angelwarriorgame.com
